answer: Regulators face a dilemma in balancing the need to ensure that humans retain control over AI systems to prevent false positives, which can be overwhelmingly costly, while also granting AI systems sufficient autonomy to override untrustworthy human decisions to mitigate the risk of false negatives, which can lead to catastrophic outcomes. This creates a complex challenge of calibrating AI autonomy and structuring trust relationships between humans and AI systems in high-stakes contexts.
